title: Obama Foundation Leaders programme
overview: Annual leadership programme for emerging leaders from Africa, Asia-Pacific, Europe and the United States. Applications open each November for the following year.
program_dates: Leaders Africa: six months, virtual (Leaders Asia-Pacific eight months hybrid; Europe and USA eight months virtual)
deadline_text: Official page, 29 October 2026: 'Applications live on November 9! Please check back here to apply, then.' The page gives no year and no closing date. Its general rule is that applicants 'may apply in November of the preceding year to join the program', so 9 November is read as 9 November 2026. Re-read on 9 November 2026 at 07:31 UTC: the Leaders page and the Leaders Africa page still showed the same sentence (the call was not yet live).
expected_next_cycle: Applications open on 9 November (the page gives no year; read with the page's rule of applying in November of the preceding year, this is 9 November 2026). No closing date announced as of 29 October 2026.
funding_details: Leaders Africa FAQ (written for the 2026-2027 cohort): 'Participants selected for the Obama Foundation Leaders program incur no fees.'
'Leaders will not be paid a stipend.' The Foundation does not offer grants or financial support for participants' work
participation_fee: None: 'Participants selected for the Obama Foundation Leaders program incur no fees' (2026-2027 FAQ)
stipend: None: 'Leaders will not be paid a stipend' (2026-2027 FAQ)
eligibility: From Africa, Asia-Pacific, Europe or the United States; Leaders Africa covers 'All nations and territories on/in the continent'
Between the ages of 24 and 45 during the programme (the 2026-2027 FAQ measured it on 1 September 2026)
2026-2027 FAQ: citizen or permanent resident of an eligible country (or a refugee or asylum seeker there, or five years' residence), living in the region for the whole programme
2026-2027 FAQ: at least three years of relevant experience in your issue area, and a leadership position in changemaking work, full-time or volunteer
2026-2027 FAQ: 8 to 12 hours a month of virtual programming (Wednesdays from 18:00 Central Africa Time), coaching and community groups
experience_requirement: At least three years of relevant experience in your issue area (2026-2027 FAQ)
application_process: Sign up for Obama Foundation emails to be told when applications open

sources.label: Leaders Africa Frequently Asked Questions (2026-2027 cohort: eligibility, cost, stipend, format)

eligibility_reason: African applicants aged 24 to 45 are eligible, but the latest published criteria (the Leaders Africa FAQ for 2026-2027) also ask for at least three years of relevant experience in an issue area and a leadership role in changemaking work, paid or volunteer. The profile records under one year of internships and no volunteer or changemaking role, and only an under-30 age band.
potential_issues: The last cycle's FAQ asks for three years of relevant experience in your issue area and a leadership role in changemaking work
The Leaders Africa FAQ still describes the 2026-2027 cohort; the 2027-2028 criteria may differ
No stipend; Leaders Africa is virtual, so no travel
The page gives the opening day (9 November) but no year and no closing date
benefits: Virtual group sessions, peer-led spaces and individual coaching
relevance_reason: Valuable network, but selection rewards a visible leadership record that the profile does not yet document.
action: Open the Obama Foundation Leaders Africa page again later on 9 November 2026 (the call was not live at 07:31 UTC). Apply only if you are 24 or older and hold a leadership role in changemaking work with about three years of experience in your issue area, as the last cycle required.
notes: 29 October 2026: the page now reads 'Applications live on November 9!'. On 12 October 2026 it still gave no exact dates for the next application window. 9 November 2026: the Leaders and Leaders Africa pages re-read at 07:31 UTC (call not yet live); the Leaders Africa FAQ (2026-2027 cohort) read for the first time: no fees, no stipend, entirely virtual, three years of relevant experience, professional English. Funding label set to Participation Funded on that wording.
